name: elagoht/honeypot
description: A collage plugin that stops form spam without a CAPTCHA: a decoy field people never see, and a signed timestamp that says how long the form was open.
setup:
Put `{{honeypot}}` inside each `<form method="post">` to protect, beside `{{csrfToken}}`; a form without it is not checked.
Set `"keyEnv": "HONEYPOT_KEY"` in `plugins-config.json`, and `HONEYPOT_KEY=` (`openssl rand -hex 32`) in `.env.development` and where production runs.

templateFunctions.name: honeypot
templateFunctions.doc: The invisible decoy field and signed timestamp that stop form spam bots, and protect the path the form posts to. `seconds` is the least time the form must be open before it is sent, signed into the timestamp; none by default.

collage-honeypot.description: collage-honeypot: the decoy field that stops spam bots, inside a form

config.description: A collage plugin that stops form spam without a CAPTCHA: a decoy field people never see, and a signed timestamp that says how long the form was open.

field.description: Field is the decoy's name: something a bot is keen to fill in. Default "website".

keyEnv.description: KeyEnv names the environment variable holding the signing key, hex-encoded: at least 32 random bytes, the same on every instance and across restarts. When set, it wins over Key, and an empty or non-hex variable is an error. With neither, a key is generated per process, and a form served before a restart, or by another instance, is refused.

maxAge.description: MaxAge is how long a served form stays good for. Default "24h".

minDelay.description: MinDelay is how long a form must be open before it is sent, "2s", for a form that does not choose its own with {{honeypot seconds}}. It catches a script that fetches a form and posts it back at once. Default 0: off, since a person with autofill and Enter is fast, and a script that knows the delay only has to wait it out. Anything but 0 is at least "1ms": the timestamp carries whole milliseconds.

protect.description: Protect are path prefixes whose submissions are checked even before a form naming them has been served. Default none: a path is checked once a page with a {{honeypot}} form posting to it has gone out from this process. ["/"] checks every form the site accepts, each of which must then carry {{honeypot}}.

silent.description: Silent answers a refused submission with 303 See Other to the page it came from, as an accepted form is answered, so a bot believes it succeeded and does not try another way. Default false: 400 Bad Request.

skip.description: Skip are path prefixes never checked, even under Protect. Default ["/_collage/"].
